description: Get details of one member of the Sejm (poseł, MP): name, club, electoral district and voivodeship, votes received, birth date and place, education, profession, e-mail, and whether the mandate is still held.

id.description: ID of the MP (poseł): the `id` field from get-members

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-member

active.description: Whether the mandate is still held

club.description: ID of the MP's club (see get-clubs)

districtNum.description: Number of the electoral district (okręg wyborczy)

id.description: MP ID, used by the other MP tools

inactiveCause.description: Why the mandate expired, for inactive MPs

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Get an MP
